context: Opened in summer 2026. Duties take several months, but retroactive tariffs are possible. Landed Asian polyol has set a ceiling below many European producers' costs.
internal_note: EUROPUR FY2025 report, published August 2026 - section 2.3

development: The LYB/Covestro PO/SM plant at Maasvlakte is closing permanently, winding down to the end of 2026
context: A world-scale propylene oxide plant. PO is what polyether polyol is made from, and Europe is already short of it.
internal_note: EUROPUR FY2025 report, published August 2026 - Table 24

development: INEOS has closed its propylene oxide and propylene glycol plant in Cologne indefinitely
context: A second European PO closure alongside Maasvlakte.
internal_note: EUROPUR FY2025 report, published August 2026 - Table 24

development: Dow closed its 94 kt Tertre polyether polyol plant in Belgium
